canonical_hash_encoding: SHA-256 over exact UTF-8 JSON with sorted object keys, compact separators, finite values only, and support-row array order preserved
claim_boundary: This source-only audit independently reconstructs the exact CUT3R Deform360 metric support and binds the exact arm-neutral proper-score reference. It does not open confirmation or target data, change any metric, authorize BayesianPhysTwin or Causal4D use, or establish state of the art.
manifest_entry_unit: one frozen (group_id, case_id, frame_index, random_seed) pair shared by both scored arms
manifest_roster_rule: Every frozen nonfailed source pair is represented exactly once; the Deform360 claim-bearing policy requires the complete four-object roster and zero technical failures.
reconstruction_rule: The auditor recomputes each support digest and count/dimension from retained canonical row arrays and compares the result independently with both candidate and baseline records. Equality between the two supplied record envelopes is insufficient.

row_relations.endpoint_and_seam_rows: must reference material points present in point_rows
row_relations.proper_score_rows: must reference every point row with exactly three distinct and globally consistent coordinate-axis labels
row_relations.row_order: is claim-bearing and must not be sorted or altered after metric construction
